entities.name: Winter
entities.description: A cynical, magicless human survivor of Duskmourn who sold out his best friend to Valgavoth and was later cursed as a revenant racer.

entities.name: Echoverse Winter
entities.description: The Echoverse version of Winter, whose best friend was killed by the House, who became a radically altruistic survivor leader.

entities.name: Valgavoth
entities.description: The demon of Duskmourn who bargained with Winter and curses him into service.

entities.name: Niko Aris
entities.description: A shard mage who arrived with the Wanderer and later trapped Winter in a shard.

entities.name: The Wanderer
entities.description: A visitor to Duskmourn whose Glimmer is a miniature Kyodai.

entities.name: Nashi
entities.description: A nezumi obsessed with finding his mother Tamiyo, rescued from Wickerfolk.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Nashi's mother, whom he seeks.

entities.name: Rill
entities.description: A wounded survivor held by the cult who agrees to join them.

entities.name: Sunset
entities.description: An uninjured survivor captured by the cult.

entities.name: Cult of Valgavoth
entities.description: A dangerous group in the Valley of Serenity dedicated to the demon Valgavoth.

entities.name: Wickerfolk
entities.description: Sinister creatures that held four nezumi captive and fear fire.

entities.name: Speed Demon
entities.description: A wicked entity who leads Duskmourn's possessed racing crew and never leaves Winter's side.

entities.name: Duskmourn
entities.description: A living house-plane that lures people in, isolates and hunts them.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker who took exception to Winter's treatment of Loot and confronted Jace at the finish line.

entities.name: Loot
entities.description: A navigation aide conscripted onto Duskmourn's racing team for his ability to locate Omenpaths.

entities.name: Mohar Varma
entities.description: A deposed Avishkari politician who consolidated power with Jace's help and sabotaged the race.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A mind mage planeswalker who incapacitated Winter and sought to abduct him.

entities.name: Champions of Amonkhet
entities.description: The racers who barely beat Winter to first place.

entities.name: Marina Vendrell
entities.description: Valgavoth's master in the Echoverse, whom Echoverse Winter hunts to rescue her from herself.

entities.name: Ghirapur Grand Prix
entities.description: An interplanar race whose prize is the Aetherspark.

events.summary: Valgavoth offers Winter freedom in exchange for four lives and Winter offers his best friend.
events.quote: When Valgavoth offered him freedom in exchange for four lives, he offered his best friend

events.summary: When Niko and the Wanderer arrive, Winter shields them from a razorkin and leads them to a parlor.
events.quote: Winter intervened just in time, shielding them from a dangerous razorkin

events.summary: Niko and the Wanderer rescue Nashi and defeat the Wickerfolk by exploiting their fear of fire.
events.quote: managed to rescue Nashi and defeat the Wickerfolk by exploiting their fear of fire

events.summary: Winter betrays Niko, the Wanderer and Nashi, sealing them in a room with the cult.
events.quote: were captured after a betrayal by Winter, who sealed them in the room with the cultists

events.summary: Valgavoth grants Winter's bargain by opening a door to Innistrad, but Niko captures him in a shard.
events.quote: Niko captured him in a shard

events.summary: Valgavoth chooses Winter as co-captain of Duskmourn's racing team for the Ghirapur Grand Prix.
events.quote: Winter was chosen by Valgavoth as the living representative and co-captain

events.summary: Winter mistreats Loot and gets on Chandra's bad side.
events.quote: for his callous mistreatment of Loot

events.summary: Winter's and Spitfire's cars are totaled by safety measures activated by Mohar Varma.
events.quote: autonomous safety measures activated by Mohar Varma

events.summary: Jace renders the wrecked Winter unconscious and searches his mind for Loot.
events.quote: Jace approached and rendered him unconscious with his mental magic

events.summary: The Champions of Amonkhet barely beat Winter to first place and a door to Duskmourn drags him inside.
events.quote: a door to Duskmourn opened at his location, and he was dragged inside

events.summary: Valgavoth imprisons Winter in the House again and curses him into servitude.
events.quote: Valgavoth imprisoned Winter in the House once more

events.summary: Echoverse Winter hunts Valgavoth's master Marina Vendrell to rescue her from herself.
events.quote: Winter hunted Valgavoth's master, Marina Vendrell

relations.note: Cursed into serving the demon's will.
relations.quote: has further cursed Winter into serving his will

relations.note: Captured Winter in a shard after his betrayal.
relations.quote: Niko captured him in a shard

relations.note: Leads the crew alongside the Speed Demon, who never leaves his side.
relations.quote: He leads a doomed crew of possessed racers alongside a wicked entity known as the Speed Demon
consolidated power with the help of the planeswalker Jace Beleren
